messages:
samir: Hey team, first day  I connected the VPN via SSO but can't hit bastion.redwood.internal or pull from registry.internal:5000. Client says connected. Any quick checks?

it-bot: Welcome @samir! Tagging @izzy (IT) and @netops. Onboarding guide: https://internal.redwood/onboarding/vpn.

izzy: Hi Samir, welcome! Are you on company laptop or BYOD and which VPN client/version?

samir: BYOD MacBook, macOS 14.4, using SecureTunnel 5.2. Client UI shows "Split tunnel: enabled".

netops: Likely split-tunnel not receiving pushed routes/DNS. Can you run `netstat -rn | grep 10.` and `scutil --dns` and paste outputs?

samir: `netstat -rn | grep 10.` -> no results. `scutil --dns` only shows my ISP DNS.

izzy: Yep, DNS/routes not applied. Temporary workarounds: 1) toggle "Route all traffic" in SecureTunnel prefs and reconnect; 2) SSH via public jump with a short firewall exception. Which do you prefer?

samir: Could you open the firewall exception? Need to pull a base image.

netops: Done, opened 25m window for your public IP and added a temporary rule for repo pulls. Try `ssh -J samir@jump.pub.redwood ubuntu@10.15.4.2` and paste failures if any.

samir: SSH connects but `docker pull registry.internal:5000/base:latest` stalls at TLS handshake. `curl -v https://registry.internal:5000/v2/` shows cert CN=registry.internal but host resolves to registry.int.redwood earlier in DNS tests on another device.

izzy: That sounds like cert SAN mismatch + DNS leakage. For short term use the registry IP (https://10.15.4.3:5000). We'll add corp SAN to the cert; ticket ONB-5021 created. Also netops, can you push 10.15.0.0/16 and DNS 10.15.0.10 to SecureTunnel 5.x onboarding profile?

netops: Done. Pushed routes/DNS for profile family `onboard-2026`. Restart SecureTunnel in ~2m. Also note some 5.x clients ignore DNS push; if restart doesn't work we may need client logs/profile id.

samir: Restarted client -> `netstat -rn | grep 10.` shows routes, `dig bastion.redwood.internal @10.15.0.10` returns 10.15.1.5, SSH and docker pull by name both work now. Thanks folks!

izzy: Great, I'll add you to the "VPN-Onboarded" Okta group so this persists and close ONB-5021 when the cert update is done. Quick onboarding note: company-managed devices avoid these extra steps; BYOD supported but please paste client version and `netstat` output into the ticket to speed triage.

samir: Got it, thanks for the fast help :rocket:
